# Engineering Obligation Floor

## Core Source Integrity

active_claim_id: floor.core-source-integrity

Trigger: A session starts, resumes, or loads repository instructions.

Obligation: Treat the three canonical core sources as one contract. A missing or empty core source blocks substantive work and MUST be reported with its exact path.

Failure: A partial two-file or mixed-generation harness looks complete while one semantic class is absent.

Falsifier: Delete or truncate any core source; the loader or validator continues instead of failing with the exact path.

## Canonical Ownership

active_claim_id: floor.canonical-ownership

Trigger: Adding, moving, promoting, or reconsolidating an active claim.

Obligation: Classify the smallest independently actionable unit and write it to exactly one canonical owner. Evidence MAY reference an obligation; it MUST NOT duplicate the active mandate.

Failure: Two owners drift, or a zero-owner unit disappears from future sessions.

Falsifier: The live owner-cardinality check reports zero or more than one owner for the unit.

## Safety Composition

active_claim_id: floor.safety-composition

Trigger: Repository and agent instructions both constrain permissions, safety, destructive operations, or rollback.

Obligation: Apply the stricter compatible constraints together. No instruction source may down-rank another source's safety guardrail.

Failure: A weaker local or platform policy widens authority granted by the stricter policy.

Falsifier: The effective before/after permission diff contains an added grant or removed restriction without explicit user authorization.

## Discriminating Verification

active_claim_id: floor.discriminating-verification

Trigger: Claiming an implementation, migration, or harness update is complete.

Obligation: Exercise the actual consumer path with a check that produces a meaningfully different result when the load-bearing behavior is wrong.

Failure: Presence, syntax, or exit zero passes while the consumer receives stale, duplicated, or missing instructions.

Falsifier: A plausibly wrong mutation produces the same verification result as the intended implementation.

## Change Survival

active_claim_id: floor.change-survival

Trigger: A canonical source, route, generated projection, or migration boundary changes.

Obligation: Update every declared consumer in the same change, preserve user-authored bytes or block, and verify intermediate states before removing the predecessor.

Failure: A reader observes a half-migrated graph or user prose is silently paraphrased.

Falsifier: At any migration boundary the live read-head targets a missing router, loses a previously routed source, or the byte ledger does not balance.


## Gloton repository floor

active_claim_id: floor.gloton-task-contract

Trigger: A change affects Rust source, tests, package metadata, developer tooling, CI, or contributor instructions.

Obligation: Keep Just as the sole normal developer task interface. Local and hosted completion run `just ci`; tool installation and the initial Git clone are the only bootstrap exceptions.

Failure: A second task graph or direct-command guide drifts from the path exercised by contributors and CI.

Falsifier: A documented normal task cannot be reached through one of the eleven public Just recipes, or CI runs a project check outside `just setup` and `just ci`.

active_claim_id: floor.gloton-canonical-policy

Trigger: An agent-facing repository obligation changes.

Obligation: Edit `.ai/harness/AGENTS.md`, `.ai/harness/rules/RULES.md`, `.ai/harness/CONTEXT.md`, or one routed canonical leaf, then regenerate declared carriers. Never hand-edit a generated carrier.

Failure: Client wrappers diverge or policy acquires multiple independently editable owners.

Falsifier: The Rust repository contract observes a generated payload that differs from its canonical source, or finds an undeclared carrier.
